newsitem.title: ITALY: LIFFE seen deciding on Dec Btp coupon by May 23.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE seen deciding on Dec Btp coupon by May 23.

text.p: The London International Financial Futures and Options Exchange (LIFFE) will decide on a new nominal coupon for the December Btp contract by May 23, a LIFFE source said.
May 23 is the day when options on the new expiry begin to be quoted.
"Operators are mainly leaning towards a coupon of between seven and nine percent but a decision has yet to be taken," the source said, commenting on Italian weekend press reports.

The contract's nominal coupon should therefore differ from the six percent coupon contract recently introduced by the Italian MIF futures market, trading alongside the 12 percrent June contract already listed and so preventing arbitrage between the two markets, Italian operators said.

They said the nominal six percent coupon was too low with respect to market levels. But even the current 12 percent contract was not working given that it involved as "cheapest to deliver" old and illiquid instruments whose high coupon prevented short-covering.
"And the difference in terms of basis points between the cheapest to deliver and the second cheapest deliverable instrument is enormous," one operator added.

Operators said the original idea of waiting to modify the specifications of the contract until May 1998, that is after the decision about EMU in and out members, seemed to have faded away unless however there was a last minute change of mind.
